info.title: Yami Shibai 5
info.synopsis: Yami Shibai 5 (Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories) è una anime horror. Ogni pomeriggio alle cinque, un uomo mascherato, il Gaito kamishibaiya, appare al parco giochi. Si presenta sempre con un teatrino mobile, col quale rappresenta, attraverso la tecnica del kamishibai, diverse storie dell'orrore e leggende metropolitane autoconclusive, con figure e temi tipici del folclore giapponese.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The story of a family leading a rather affluent lifestyle. A young woman realized her dream and married an elite businessman. However, contrary to her ideal, her new husband works so much that he has no time for his family, and things aren't going as smoothly as she'd imagined with her new stepchild. One day, as she's beginning to feel he exhaustion of this new life wearing on her, she receives a phone call. It sounds like someone's tried to call the nursery school and reached her by mistake...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The story of a certain office lady. On her way home from work, she meets a young girl in the park who persistently asks her to give her things. The moment she begins to see her past self in this young girl, things take a frightening turn. Can she escape the darkness of material desire?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The story of a woman and her young daughter visiting family in the countryside. On the way there, they meet a somewhat eerie-looking old woman dressed all in black, and this meeting entangles the mother and daughter in something disturbing. What did the little girl see in a seemingly ordinary flock of crows?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The story of two girls who have been together in all things since they were children. Yukari has always been the type who wanted to do everything her best friend Haru did. It's unclear whether she acts out of envy, love, or madness, but her feelings become a darkness that leads to a tragic fate...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The story of a woman who wishes for happiness after getting married. However, her husband always comes home late from work, leaving her feeling doubtful.
